name: 🔥 Buffalo Chicken Wraps
tagline: Saucy buffalo chicken, cool ranch crunch, rolled tight and toasted so it holds.

items.name: Frank's RedHot, plus more to taste

steps.text: Slice each chicken breast in half the long way so it cooks fast and even. Season with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Sear in a little oil over medium-high, 5–6 minutes a side, until 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then chop or shred.
Whisk the melted butter into the Frank's. Toss the chicken in it while it's hot.
Set out lettuce, cheese, celery and ranch in bowls.
Warm the tortillas 20 seconds in the microwave. Fill: lettuce, chicken, cheese, celery, a drizzle of ranch.
Fold the sides in and roll tight. Toast seam side down in a dry skillet, 1–2 minutes a side, until golden.
Cut in half on an angle. Carrots and extra ranch on the side. Pack the extra chicken for lunch before rolling.

kid_jobs.job: Shred lettuce and fill the topping bowls
Roll the wraps: sides in, then roll tight
Plate the carrots and ranch for dipping

chef_tip: Toss the chicken in the buffalo butter while it's still hot so it soaks in, and toast the wrap seam side down first to seal it shut.
make_ahead: Cook and sauce the chicken up to 2 days ahead; warm it before rolling.
leftovers: The second batch of chicken makes lunch wraps or a buffalo salad with ranch.
swaps: Rotisserie chicken when time is tight
Go easy on the Frank's for milder eaters: sauce half the chicken
heads_up: Slice the chicken breasts in half the long way before anything else.

game_plan.what: Halve the chicken the long way and season it.
Chicken in the skillet, 5–6 min a side. Kids set out the fillings.
Chicken rests. Kids whisk butter into the Frank's.
Chop and toss the chicken in the sauce. Pack lunch chicken.
Warm tortillas, fill and roll tight.
Toast the wraps seam side down until golden.
Cut on an angle; carrots and ranch on the side.
